description: The minor findings from the M6 review (.agents/tasks/m6-match-room/verdict.json, all six) and the M7 review (.agents/tasks/m7-rest-api/verdict.json, all except the first, CSRF/403, which stays untouched): plan.md decision 6 and checklist P1-P10. Independent of FEAT-001/002 except that the PATCH game cases in routes.db.spec.ts rely on FEAT-001's `game` field.
steps: P1: new src/lib/chat.ts `mergeMessages(loaded: ChatMessage[], received: ChatMessage[]): ChatMessage[]` (Map by id over [...loaded, ...received], sorted by createdAt then id; `import type { ChatMessage } from '#lib/server/services/chat.ts'`) and src/lib/chat.spec.ts (dedupe, order, a received message missing from a reload is kept). In src/routes/t/[org]/[tournament]/matches/[id]/+page.svelte replace `let messages = $derived(data.messages)` with `let received = $state<ChatMessage[]>([])` + `const messages = $derived(mergeMessages(data.messages, received))`; the chat handler appends to `received`.

P2: src/lib/live.ts: wrap creation in `connect()`; on `error`, call onstatus(false) and, when `source.readyState === EventSource.CLOSED`, `retry = setTimeout(connect, 3000)` with a comment (EventSource only retries network errors; an HTTP error such as a 502 while the app restarts closes it; 3000 ms matches the server's `retry`); cleanup `() => { clearTimeout(retry); source.close(); }`. Update the doc comment. New src/lib/live.spec.ts: `vi.mock('$app/navigation', () => ({ invalidateAll: vi.fn() }))`, a FakeEventSource stubbed with `vi.stubGlobal` (static CONNECTING/OPEN/CLOSED, readyState, addEventListener/dispatch, close, an instances array), `vi.useFakeTimers()`; cases: open -> onstatus(true) and invalidateAll; error while CONNECTING -> onstatus(false), no new instance after 3000 ms; error when CLOSED -> a second instance after 3000 ms; cleanup closes and cancels a pending retry. If vi.mock of $app/navigation fails in the server project, add an optional `reload = invalidateAll` parameter instead and pass a spy.

P3: src/routes/t/[org]/[tournament]/matches/[id]/+page.server.ts `report`: `return outcome === 'disputed' ? undefined : { saved: m.room_saved, agreed: m.room_agreed }[outcome]();` with a comment that the result card already shows the dispute as a warning.

P4: new src/lib/components/LiveStatus.svelte `{ connected }: { connected: boolean | null }` rendering `{connected === null ? m.live_connecting() : connected ? m.live_on() : m.live_off()}` with the `.live` styles moved from both pages; add en.json `live_connecting: 'Connecting…'`. Use it in matches/+page.svelte and matches/[id]/+page.svelte with `let connected = $state(null);` and delete their duplicated `.live` CSS.

P5: src/routes/t/[org]/[tournament]/matches/+page.svelte: the `link` snippet takes an optional `context` flag (or a second snippet) so rows in the 'Your matches' section also render `{#if context}{matchContext(match)}{/if}`; per-stage lists stay as they are. Import matchContext from '#lib/labels.ts'.

P6: src/lib/server/services/matches.db.spec.ts: requestHelp rejects for the waiting final ('M2-1' before the semis) and when the tournament isn't running (before start); a round robin (setStructure with stage('round_robin') like tournaments.db.spec.ts) where both players report [1, 1] -> 'agreed', item status 'completed', result.winner null; postMessage with a match id of another tournament (second tournament started in the same org) rejects with kind 'not_found'; describe('match room') imports `load` from '../../../routes/t/[org]/[tournament]/matches/[id]/+page.server' and calls it with a fake event `{ params: { org: 'club', tournament: 'cup', id }, locals: { user: owner, session, trusted: false }, url }` for an org member who isn't playing -> `organizer: false`, `canSet: false`, `canPost: false`; with `trusted: true` -> organizer true. e2e/matches.e2e.ts: in the dispute test assert `four.getByText("The reports don't match, so an organizer will decide the result.")` toHaveCount(1); after the organizer's message shows in `two`'s log, assert `one.getByRole('log')` not.toContainText('How can I help?').

P7: src/lib/server/api/responses.ts: `export async function requireApiMatch(tournamentId: string, matchId: string)` (getMatch, error(404, 'Match not found.') when undefined; doc: 'A played match of the tournament. Byes aren't shown, so they aren't found either.'); `matchDetail` uses it. Call it before the service in routes .../matches/[matchId]/messages (GET replaces its inline check, POST), result (PUT, DELETE), reports (POST) and help (DELETE).

P8: src/lib/server/services/requirements.ts parseModuleConfig: `if (!module.tournamentConfig) return { ok: true, config: {} };` with the doc comment 'Modules without options store `{}`.'; src/lib/server/services/requirements.spec.ts: a module without tournamentConfig (e.g. `devModule` from '#lib/server/modules/auth/dev.ts' if it is pure, or a minimal fake AuthModule) turns `{ foo: 1 }` into `{}`.

P9: src/lib/server/api/schemas.ts: drop 'bye' from MATCH_STATUSES (keep `satisfies readonly MatchProgress[]`); responses.ts toMatch: `status: item.progress as Exclude<MatchProgress, 'bye'>` with a comment that listMatches leaves byes out.

P10: new src/lib/server/api/routes.db.spec.ts: beforeEach resetDatabase, owner, org, API key (createApiKey), tournament; a `call(handler, { method, params, body, query })` helper building `{ request, url, params } as unknown as RequestEvent` with `authorization: Bearer <key>` and `content-type: application/json` (pattern: handler.db.spec.ts); import route modules relatively, e.g. `import * as tournamentRoute from '../../../routes/api/v1/tournaments/[tournamentId]/+server'`. Cases: PATCH partial body keeps the other fields; startsAt '2030-05-01T18:00:00Z' is stored as that Date; `game: null` -> null; `game: { appId: 10 }` -> 422 (db tests have no STEAM_API_KEY); PUT theme 200 / 422 unknown; GET + PUT requirements: dev with `{ foo: 1 }` stores `{}`, unknown module 422, 409 after start; POST unpublish (registration, nobody signed up -> draft), POST open-check-in -> check_in; POST start-next-stage -> 409 with one stage; POST shuffle -> 200 participants; PUT check-in -> checkedInAt set; DELETE participant -> 204 and gone; DELETE tournament -> 409 when published, 204 for a draft; an SE of 3 has a `bye` row (select from matches where status 'bye'): POST messages, PUT result, DELETE result, POST reports and DELETE help on it -> 404, no match_messages row, the row's updatedAt unchanged, a help_requested=true set directly stays true; GET messages lists posted messages; GET matches `?status=bye` -> 400; GET /steam/apps?q=x -> [] without a key and 400 without q.
Record in `findings` anything FEAT-005 needs for the notes (e.g. reconnect behaviour).
acceptance_criteria: All six M6 findings and the four non-CSRF M7 findings are fixed as described; nothing in the CSRF setup changed.
`corepack pnpm test:unit --run` passes with the new chat.spec.ts, live.spec.ts, routes.db.spec.ts and the added matches.db.spec.ts and requirements.spec.ts cases.
`e2e/matches.e2e.ts` passes with the dispute-once and room-isolation assertions, and `e2e/api.e2e.ts` still passes.
`corepack pnpm check` reports 0 errors and 0 warnings.
findings: Done, uncommitted, CSRF untouched. New: src/lib/chat.ts `mergeMessages(loaded, received)` (Map by id, sorted by createdAt then id) + chat.spec.ts (4); the room keeps `received = $state<ChatMessage[]>([])` and derives `messages = mergeMessages(data.messages, received)`. src/lib/live.ts: `connect()` per EventSource; on `error` it calls onstatus(false) and, only when that instance's readyState is EventSource.CLOSED (an HTTP error such as a 502 while the app restarts; network errors are retried by the browser), schedules a new EventSource after 3000 ms (= the server's `retry: 3000`); each new open reloads the page data via invalidateAll; cleanup clears the timer and closes the current instance. live.spec.ts (6) uses `vi.mock('$app/navigation')` (works in the server project; no `reload` parameter added), a FakeEventSource via vi.stubGlobal and fake timers. New src/lib/components/LiveStatus.svelte `{ connected: boolean | null }` (`<span class="live" role="status" data-testid="live">`, null = 'Connecting…' = new en.json key `live_connecting`), used by matches/+page.svelte and matches/[id]/+page.svelte, which start at `null`; their `.live` CSS is gone. Room `report` action returns nothing for `disputed` (the result card's `alert warning` shows it once). 'Your matches' rows render `matchContext(match)` via `link(match, true)` (span.muted.context). M7: `requireApiMatch(tournamentId, matchId)` in api/responses.ts (404 'Match not found.'; matchDetail uses it) called before the service in messages GET/POST, result PUT/DELETE, reports POST, help DELETE. parseModuleConfig returns `{}` for modules without tournamentConfig. 'bye' removed from MATCH_STATUSES (schemas.ts); toMatch casts `item.progress as Exclude<MatchProgress, 'bye'>` (listMatches/getMatch leave byes out). Tests: matches.db.spec.ts +5 (help on a waiting final, help after the tournament completed, round robin draw agreed with winner null, postMessage on another tournament's match -> not_found, room `load` for a member: trusted false -> organizer/canSet/canPost false, trusted true -> true); requirements.spec.ts +1; new src/lib/server/api/routes.db.spec.ts (19 tests: PATCH partial/startsAt/game keep-422-null, DELETE tournament 409/204, theme 200/422, requirements dev {foo:1} -> {} / 422 / 409 after start, unpublish, open-check-in, start-next-stage 409, shuffle, check-in, DELETE participant 204, matches ?status=ready 200 / ?status=bye 400, GET+POST messages, bye match: 6 calls -> 404 and the row unchanged incl. help_requested=true, GET /steam/apps [] / 400). e2e/matches.e2e.ts: dispute text count 1 on `four`, `one`'s log doesn't contain 'How can I help?'. Verified: format, check 0/0, lint clean, test:unit 34 files / 396 tests pass, test:e2e matches+api 5 passed. Notes for PLAN.md M8: the live badge starts at 'Connecting…' and is announced (role=status); the client reconnects after HTTP errors every 3 s; chat merges by id; API write routes 404 on byes before any write; `bye` isn't an API status any more; option-less requirement configs are stored as `{}`.
